metadata.title: Pharmacovigilance Regulations (S.L. 458.35; Legal Notice 369 of 2012, as amended by Legal Notices 352 of 2013, 305 of 2014 and 234 of 2022)
metadata.edition: Consolidated text, point in time 1 January 2022; headed 30th October, 2012 · reg. 6(5) national contact person on request; reg. 14(1) public announcements; reg. 17 serious reactions to EudraVigilance within fifteen days; reg. 18(1) non-serious within ninety days (English)
metadata.legal_basis: Subsidiary legislation under the Medicines Act (Cap. 458) of Malta; the text on legislation.mt governs.
metadata.applicability: Marketing authorisation holders (see the PV Info MMA-MT national addendum; ICSR clocks are in the EMA rulebook).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
